UpdateSourceArgs: -c "ROOT=\"{{$FullRootDir}}\"; DATA=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}\"; ITEM=\"{{WorkshopItemID}}\"; SUSER='{{SteamUsername}}'; SPASS='{{SteamPassword}}'; SGUARD='{{SteamGuardCode}}'; mkdir -p \"$ROOT\" \"$DATA\" \"${ROOT}steamhome\"; if [ -z \"$SUSER\" ]; then echo 'Set the Steam Username setting (Configuration -> Steam Workshop Update) before running an update.'; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -x \"${ROOT}steamcmd.sh\" ]; then echo 'Installing SteamCMD...'; wget -qO \"${ROOT}steamcmd.tar.gz\" https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || exit 1; tar -xzf \"${ROOT}steamcmd.tar.gz\" -C \"$ROOT\" || exit 1; rm -f \"${ROOT}steamcmd.tar.gz\"; fi; if [ -n \"$SPASS\" ]; then set -- +login \"$SUSER\" \"$SPASS\" $SGUARD; else set -- +login \"$SUSER\"; fi; LOG=\"${ROOT}steamcmd-last.log\"; HOME=\"${ROOT}steamhome\" \"${ROOT}steamcmd.sh\" \"$@\" +workshop_download_item 261550 \"$ITEM\" validate +quit 2>&1 | tee \"$LOG\"; EXE=\"${ROOT}steamhome/Steam/steamapps/workshop/content/261550/${ITEM}/DedicatedServer/BannerlordCoopServer.exe\"; if [ ! -f \"$EXE\" ]; then if grep -qE 'Invalid Password|Cached credentials not found|Account Logon Denied|Two-factor|Rate Limit' \"$LOG\"; then echo 'STEAM LOGIN FAILED. This instance has no cached Steam token yet. Set BOTH the Steam Password AND a FRESH Steam Guard Code (they expire in ~30s) in Configuration -> Steam Workshop Update, click Update, then clear both fields again. A newly created or recreated instance always needs this once.'; else echo \"Workshop download failed - BannerlordCoopServer.exe not found at $EXE.
